sentences.text: Wukongopterus is a basal pterosaur genus discovered in the Tiaojishan Formation of Liaoning, China, with an estimated wingspan of 730 mm.
Evidence suggests the type individual broke its shin while alive.

The genus was described and named in 2009 by Wang Xiaolin, Alexander Kellner, Jiang Shunxing, and Meng Xi, with the specific name honoring Li Yutong, a senior preparator at the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology.
Researchers suggest Wukongopterus may have possessed an uropatagium, a membrane between its hind legs.
Wukongopterus is classified within the family Wukongopteridae.
Wukongopterus lived between 168.2 and 152.21 million years ago during the Bathonian to Kimmeridgian stages.
